Nikolaevka village is situated in Municipality Suvorovo, Varna district. It is situated 350 m above sea level. The inhabitants are about 450.

Village is popular among fishermen for its beautiful scenery and clean reservoirs. Ongoing international fishing competitions.
Land in the village is fertile. Has developed agriculture and vegetable production.

Good infrastructure. The village has a post office, church, shops, restaurant, cafe. There is mobile phone coverage. Regular bus service to the city of Varna and its surrounding villages.
Beautiful scenery, presence of dams and proximity to Varna make village Nikolaevka preferred place to live and vacation.
